import subprocess, re

def read_fasta(fn):
    d={}; name=None
    for line in open(fn):
        line=line.strip()
        if not line: continue
        if line.startswith('>'):
            name=line[1:]; d[name]=''
        else:
            d[name]+=line.lower()

seqs=read_fasta('/app/sequences.fasta')

    return ''.join(c[x] for x in reversed(s))

flag_core = flag[3:-3]     # drop atg start and stop

# annealing region generators
# fwd: template top strand slice starting at 'start' going right, length L
# rev: template top strand slice ending at 'end', length L; primer anneal seq = rc(slice)
def scan_fwd(template,start):
    res={}
    for L in range(15,46):
        seg=template[start:start+L]
        if len(seg)<L: break
        res[L]=(seg, tm(seg))
    return res
def scan_rev(template,end):
    res={}
    for L in range(15,46):
        seg=template[end-L:end]
        if len(seg)<L or end-L<0: break
        primer=rc(seg)
        res[L]=(primer, tm(primer))
    return res

# backbone downstream template = input[690:], upstream ends at input index 210
# For input fwd anneal: starts at input[694:] (after OH4 tgag = input[690:694])
inp_fwd = scan_fwd(inp,694)
# input rev anneal: top strand ending at 210 (backbone upstream end), overhang rc(OH1)
inp_rev = scan_rev(inp,210)

egfp_fwd = scan_fwd(egfp,4)          # after OH1 atga=egfp[0:4]
egfp_rev = scan_rev(egfp,len(egfp)-3) # end of egfp_core
flag_fwd = scan_fwd(flag,7)          # after OH2=flag[3:7]
flag_rev = scan_rev(flag,len(flag)-3)
snap_fwd = scan_fwd(snap,7)          # after OH3=snap[3:7]
snap_rev = scan_rev(snap,len(snap))  # end of snap (incl stop)

def pick(fwd,rev,label):
    best=None
    for lf,(sf,tf) in fwd.items():
        if not (58<=tf<=72): continue
        for lr,(sr,tr) in rev.items():
            if not (58<=tr<=72): continue
            if abs(tf-tr)>5: continue
            score=abs(tf-tr)+0.1*(abs(tf-64)+abs(tr-64))
            if best is None or score<best[0]:
                best=(score,lf,sf,tf,lr,sr,tr)
    print(label,'-> fwd L%d Tm%.2f | rev L%d Tm%.2f | diff %.2f'%(best[1],best[3],best[4],best[6],abs(best[3]-best[6])))
    return best

r_inp=pick(inp_fwd,inp_rev,'input')
r_egfp=pick(egfp_fwd,egfp_rev,'egfp')
r_flag=pick(flag_fwd,flag_rev,'flag')
r_snap=pick(snap_fwd,snap_rev,'snap')

def build_fwd(template,start,L,oh): return fwd(oh,template[start:start+L])
def build_rev(template,end,L,oh): return fwd(oh,rc(template[end-L:end]))
